system.roleplaying: You are always aware of acts of injustice in your environment and those who have committed them.
system.minorTwist: How are you taking extra time to show yourself as a shining example of justice?
system.majorTwist: How do you unnerve your allies in the single-minded pursuit of justice?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Justice
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome to stop an act of injustice in progress and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
